scripts.content: uv run -q --no-project --python 3.14 --with numpy==2.4.6 --with pandas==3.0.2 --with scikit-learn==1.8.0 --with ruff==0.17.0 python tools/content_check.py
scripts.dev: pnpm palette && pnpm content --if-changed && pnpm pyodide && vite
scripts.build: pnpm palette && pnpm content && pnpm pyodide && vite build
scripts.test:py: uv run -q --no-project --python 3.14 --with numpy==2.4.6 --with pandas==3.0.2 --with scikit-learn==1.8.0 --with ruff==0.17.0 --with mypy==2.4.1 --with coverage==7.17.0 sh -c "coverage erase && coverage run --rcfile=tools/coverage.ini -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' && coverage combine --rcfile=tools/coverage.ini -q && coverage report --rcfile=tools/coverage.ini"
scripts.lint:py: uv run -q --no-project --python 3.14 --with ruff==0.17.0 --with vulture==2.16 sh -c 'ruff check tools py && vulture tools/vet py --min-confidence 80'
scripts.typecheck:py: uv run -q --no-project --python 3.14 --with mypy==2.4.1 mypy --config-file tools/mypy.ini tools/vet tools/content_check.py py
scripts.worker:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply code-village --local --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
